_meta.openai/toolInvocation/invoked: Done: Find recalls of similar products

description: Find recalls of products like this one in the US (CPSC), Canada (Health Canada) and the EU (Safety Gate), usually from the last 2 years. Pass product as a plain product type, such as plush toy or baby walker, and origin to keep only products made in one country. Returns each recall's title, date, hazard and link, per region. Use it to see which hazards regulators find in this product type before testing. A recall of a similar product is not a finding about the user's product.

origin.description: Only recalls of products made in this country, such as China or Vietnam, where the source records it

product.description: The product type in plain words, such as "plush toy", "baby walker" or "kids rain jacket"

regions.description: Regions to search: US, CA (Canada), EU (default: all three)

withinDays.description: Only recalls from the last this many days (default 730)

name: match_recalls
title: Find recalls of similar products
